event.description: Fix a second block-1 pre-FF scale to neutral
event.proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 2,118 parameters at 99.050000%, a +0.050000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 22 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0059 at 2,118 parameters and 99.05%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0060, where a block-0 ln1 scale neutralization scored 92.29%. At the successful block-1 ln2 site, the next scale by neutral deviation is coordinate 5 at 0.747436225. Hypothesis: fixing it to one cumulatively with coordinate 12 preserves qualification and yields 2,117 parameters. This is more informative than another block-0 scale because attempt-0060 showed that site is highly sensitive, while this test directly probes remaining redundancy at the successful pre-feed-forward site.
